description: This file defines the Perl package LightyTest, which contains various subroutines to facilitate testing of the lighttpd web server. It includes methods for starting and stopping processes, handling HTTP requests and responses, managing sockets, and checking server features.

classes.name: LightyTest
classes.description: A class encapsulating methods for testing and managing a lighttpd server, including process control, socket handling, and HTTP request/response processing.

methods.name: mtime
methods.description: Returns the modification time of a specified file.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for the LightyTest class, initializing paths, environment, and server configuration.

methods.name: listening_on
methods.description: Checks if a server is listening on a specified port.

methods.name: stop_proc
methods.description: Terminates the server process if running.

methods.name: wait_for_port_with_proc
methods.description: Waits for a server to start listening on a port, with a timeout, also handling process reaping.

methods.name: bind_ephemeral_tcp_socket
methods.description: Creates and binds a TCP socket to an ephemeral port on localhost.

methods.name: get_ephemeral_tcp_port
methods.description: Returns an ephemeral port number by binding and then closing a socket.

methods.name: cygpath_alm
methods.description: Converts a Windows path to Cygwin or MSYS Unix-style path.

methods.name: start_proc
methods.description: Starts the lighttpd server process, setting environment variables, socket activation, and executing the server.

methods.name: handle_http
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request and processes the response for testing purposes.

methods.name: spawnfcgi
methods.description: Spawns a FastCGI application process listening on a specified port.

methods.name: has_feature
methods.description: Checks if the server binary reports support for a given feature.

methods.name: has_crypto
methods.description: Checks if the server binary supports any crypto features.
